name: B10-0071/2024 (ECR) – The democratic backsliding and threats to political pluralism in Georgia
title: Resolution on the democratic backsliding and threats to political pluralism in Georgia
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and making requests. It condemns Georgia's new "foreign agents law", which forces groups funded from abroad to register as agents of foreign influence. It calls on Georgia to hold a free and fair election on 26 October 2024, to release former president Mikheil Saakashvili, and to stop pressure on civil society. It asks the European Union to consider sanctions on Georgian officials and on oligarch Bidzina Ivanishvili.

- The law stays in place; the Parliament only condemns it and asks Georgia to change course.
- Georgians face pressure on civil society, media and the opposition ahead of the 26 October vote.
- The European Union may consider travel bans and sanctions on officials and Ivanishvili.
